title: Draw the Motion · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Draw the Motion · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a simple action such as jumping or waving. The lead draws a stick figure and motion marks to show the action. The others identify the intended action. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Draw the Motion, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The others identify the intended action.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The others identify the intended action.
